text:
deploy-bot: Deployment finished: release v2026.03.19-rc2 -> eu-west-1 (canary 10%)
mira: Observing synthetic probe failure rate increase in eu-west around 09:12 UTC. Error spike: tokenize_failed
jorge: I see it on dashboards — synth pass rate dropped from 99.8% to 94.2% in last 5m. p95 latency +80ms
mira: sample error logs:
```
2026-03-19T09:12:17Z ERROR tokenizer: tokenize_failed input="ú..." model=redwood-open-7B
stack: TokenizerError: invalid byte sequence
```
sam: Looks like non-utf8 chars causing tokenizer to throw in newer tokenizer lib. Did the model upgrade include tokenizer bump?
lila: Yes, rc2 included tokenizer v0.9.1 -> v1.0.0. Our fallback used to accept and normalize bytes; new one is stricter.
mira: Proposing: pause canary expansion, pin eu-west route to previous model artifact (v2026.03.18) and route 100% of eu-west canary to fallback smallq variant while we patch.
jorge: +1. Also suggests enabling prefix-KV caching bypass for affected model to reduce error surface.
sam: I'll trigger pin now. @ops-bot can you apply route pin for eu-west and update release notes?
ops-bot: Route pinning started: setting route eu-west -> model:v2026.03.18 (pinned by sam). Canaries paused.
lila: Opening PR with tokenizer normalization shim to handle non-utf8 by pre-normalizing input bytes. ETA 45m.
mira: After pin, we're already seeing synth failure rate dropping back to baseline. Will monitor for 15m then confirm rollback/rollback-cancel.
jorge: Should we roll back the entire release in all regions or keep it localized to eu-west pending root cause?
sam: Keep it localized for now. No global rollback — we need to confirm scope. Also add a regression alert for tokenizer exceptions.
mira: Notifying oncall @oncall. I'll also add a quick e2e test for non-ascii tokens to the smoke suite.
ops-bot: Postdeploy synthetic checks: eu-west synth pass 5m average=99.7% latency stable. Notifying channel.
sam: OK, leaving canary paused. Follow-up items: (1) merge tokenizer patch, (2) backfill perf tests, (3) add non-ascii test to smoke. Change window: 30m planned for patch rollout.
lila: I'll call out in release notes: 'Temporarily pinned eu-west to v2026.03.18 due to tokenizer strictness in rc2; fix in progress.'
mira: Thanks. Closing loop when patch merged and synth stable 30m.
deploy-bot: Update: canary expansion paused at 10%.
